当你下载文件时, 是否遇到过下载速度越变越慢, 导致下载进度一直在增加, 但是预计剩余下载时间 永远没有变化的绝望情况.
在这个剧本中, 我们将要研究预计剩余下载时间永远不变的条件下, 下载速度的变化趋势.
一般来说, 下载工具会采用瞬时平均速度或者移动平均速度衡量当前的下载速度, 因此这个剧本也考 虑这两张衡量方式.
在接下来的讨论中, 假设下载速度是定义在$\mathbb{R}^+$的勒贝格可积函数$v(t)$, 它满足$0\le \int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}<1, t\ge 0$, 并且预计下载时间为常数$c$.
如果使用瞬时平均速度来表示下载时间, 那么$t$时刻的预计下载时间就是剩余进度与$v(t)$的比值, 此 时下载速度满足方程$c=\frac{1}{v\left( t \right)}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $. 因此第一个问题就是:

LongSpeak.Content: 1.设$v(t)>0$是定义在$[0,+\infty)$的勒贝格可积函数, 满足方程$c=\frac{1}{v\left( t \right)}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $, 求解$v(t)$.

Speak.Content: 而如果使用移动平均速度来表示预计剩余下载时间, 那么进一步假设采取了前$\tau$时刻内的平均速度作 为移动平均深度, 此时t时刻的平均速度为$\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{t-\varepsilon}^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}$, 此时t时刻的下载速度满足方程\\ $c=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{t-\varepsilon}^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $
注意移动平均速度只在$t\ge \varepsilon $时有意义, 因此还需要追加假设$v\left( t \right) =v_0\left( t \right) ,t\in \left[ 0,\varepsilon \right) $. 总之, 第二个问题 就是:

LongSpeak.Content: 2.设$v(t)>0$是定义在$[0,+\infty)$的勒贝格可积函数, 满足方程 $$c=\frac{1}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{t-\varepsilon}^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right),$$ 以及初值条件$v\left( t \right) =v_0\left( t \right) ,t\in \left[ 0,\varepsilon \right) $,求解$v(t)$.

Speak.Content: 现在来求解第一个问题，移项后可得$v\left( t \right) =\frac{1}{c}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $，因为等式左边是连续的，故$v(t)$连续，进而$\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}$可导且$\left( \int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\prime}=v\left( t \right) $。
因此化简可得$e^{-\frac{t}{c}}\left( e^{\frac{t}{c}}\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\prime}=\frac{1}{c}$

进而$e^{\frac{t}{c}}\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=e^{\frac{t}{c}}-1$, 化简可得$\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=1-e^{-\frac{t}{c}}$, 进而$v\left( t \right) =\frac{1}{c}e^{-\frac{t}{c}}$.
这意味着此时下载速度随时间的增加指数衰减. 此外$\int_0^{+\infty}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=1$, 这意味着经过无穷的时间后下 载终将完成, 也意味着只要你等待的时间足够久, 你能看到进度条上的下载进度为99\%, 99.9\%, 99.99\%...
现在让我们整理一下分析的过程, 写一下具体的答案:

LongSpeak.Content: 因为$v\left( t \right) =\frac{1}{c}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $, 故$v(t)$连续, 进而$v(t)$可导.

故$v\left( t \right) +\frac{1}{c}\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=e^{-\frac{t}{c}}\left( e^{\frac{t}{c}}\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\prime}=\frac{1}{c}$, 化简可得 $$ \int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=1-e^{-\frac{t}{c}}. $$
两边同时求导可得 $$v\left( t \right) =\frac{1}{c}e^{-\frac{t}{c}}.$$

Speak.Content: 接下来考虑第二个问题, 这个问题可能会稍微比第一个问题复杂一点.
所以让我们先考虑简单一点的问题, 也就是如果$v(t)$连续, 那么$v(t)$是什么样的?
移项可得$\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\frac{c}{\varepsilon}\int_{t-\varepsilon}^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=1.$
此时左式的每一项都是可导的, 求导可得$v\left( t \right) +\frac{c}{\varepsilon}\left( v\left( t \right) -v\left( t-\varepsilon \right) \right) =0.$
整理可得$v\left( t \right) =\left( \frac{c}{\varepsilon +c} \right) v\left( t-\varepsilon \right).$ 这意味着此时$v(t)$总可以由先前的时间递推地获取, 注意$v(t)=v_0(t)$, $t\in[0,\varepsilon)$是已知的. 因此$v(t)$可以递推地获得, 即:

LongSpeak.Content: $$ \begin{aligned} v\left( t \right) &=\left( \frac{c}{\varepsilon +c} \right) v\left( t-\varepsilon \right) =\left( \frac{c}{\varepsilon +c} \right) ^2v\left( t-2\varepsilon \right)\\ &=\cdots\\ &=\left( \frac{c}{\varepsilon +c} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}v\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) =\left( \frac{c}{\varepsilon +c} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right)\\ \end{aligned} $$

Speak.Content: 这个问题中的$c$并不是任意的,注意这个式子对$t=\varepsilon $成立, 故$\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\frac{c}{\varepsilon}\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=1$, 化简可得$\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\frac{\varepsilon}{\varepsilon +c}.$

带回$v(t)$的表达式, 可得$v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}.$

现在就来验证一下当$v(t)$仅仅是勒贝格可积时, \\$v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}$是不是方程的一个解.
注意方程出现了区间$[t-\varepsilon,t]$, 因此考虑使用之前得到的递推关系式\\$v\left( t \right) =\left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) v\left( t-\varepsilon \right) $进行证明.

两边同时在$[\varepsilon,t]$上积分, 可得:$\int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}^{}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}^{}{v\left( \tau -\varepsilon \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}$.

化简可得:$\int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0.$

现在需要验证这个等式与方程是等价的, 方程可以写成\\$\frac{1}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}\left( 1-\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) =\frac{1}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{t-\varepsilon}^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}\left( 1-\int_0^t{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $的形式.

化简可得$ \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau \int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=0.$

LongSpeak.Content:
也就是说,我们需要说明下面两个式子是等价的: $${\color{red} \int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}+\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0,$$
$${\color{red} \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}+\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau \int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=0.$

Speak.Content: 因为$\int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}$, 所以这两个式子确实是 等价的.
自此完成了整个求解的第一步, 让我们整理一下:

LongSpeak.Content: 第一步\,\,\,\,首先证明 $$ v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]} $$ \\ 是方程的一个解.

即$v\left( t \right) =v\left( t-\varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)$. 两边在$[\varepsilon,t]$上积分，可得 $$ \int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0. $$

而对于原方程, 取$t=\varepsilon$, 可得 \[ c=\frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=\frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\frac{1}{\varepsilon}\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}. \]

化简可得 \[ \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau \int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=0. \]

注意 \[\int_{\left[ \varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_{\left[ 0,t-\varepsilon \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}.\] 故两式是等价的, 即 \[v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}\] 确实是方程的一个解.

这个结论显然在$\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right] $上是成立的, 现在希望把这个结论拓展到$\mathbb{R^+}$上.
这个时候一个常见的思路是使用勒贝格方法(详见BV1dh411u76p)

即假设集合$S=\left\{ x:\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau},\forall t\in \left[ 0,x \right] \right\}$的上确界是有限的, 然后导出矛盾.

所以现在, 假设非空集合$S=\left\{ x:\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau},\forall t\in \left[ 0,x \right] \right\}$的上确界为$T<+\infty$, 那么$\forall \delta >0,\exists \delta^\prime\in \left( T,\,T+\delta \right] $, 使得$\int_{\left[ 0,\delta ^{\prime} \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\ne 0.$
可以直接这样说明吗...?
所以现在, 需要说明一下$\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0.$
现在我们已知的是$\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0,t<T.$

容易推出$\int_{\left[ a,b \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0,\forall\, 0\le a\le b<T$, 进而\\ $\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right)}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{\int_{\left[ T-\frac{T}{n},T-\frac{T}{n+1} \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=0.$

因此确实成立$T\in S$, 并且$\forall \delta >0,\exists \delta^\prime\in \left( T,\,T+\delta \right] $, 使得$\int_{\left[ 0,\delta ^{\prime} \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\ne 0.$
现在想要导出矛盾, 所以试着利用一下已知条件. 设$t>T$, 且$u(t)$和$v(t)$是方程的两个解, 那么:

LongSpeak.Content: \[\frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=\frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}$\

Speak.Content: 这个条件化简一下就是$\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}.$
现在想要利用$\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}$这个条件.
但是完整写出来式子也太长了!
所以现在记$p=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}.$

LongSpeak.Content: 那么,$$\begin{aligned} &\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\\ &=\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+p \right) -\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+p \right)\\ &=p\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) +\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ \end{aligned}$$

Speak.Content: 只是这样并没有充分利用$\forall \delta >0,\exists \delta^\prime\in \left( T,\,T+\delta \right] $, 使得$\int_{\left[ 0,\delta ^{\prime} \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\ne 0.$这一条件.
因此进一步假设$t-\varepsilon <T$ 且$\int_{\left[ t,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ t,T \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=q.$

LongSpeak.Content: 那么\[\begin{aligned} &\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\\ &=p\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) +\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ &=p\left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) +\left( \left( q+\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\left( q+\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ &=p\left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) +q\left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ &=\left( p-q \right) \left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ &=\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right)\\ \end{aligned}\]

Speak.Content: 这样一来就得到了$\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\left( \int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \left( \int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) $. 但是\\$\int_{\left[ t-\varepsilon ,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}<1$, 故只能有$\int_{\left[ T,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0$, 矛盾.
这样就说明了$ \int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau},\forall t>0.$ 现在来整理一下过程.

LongSpeak.Content: 第二步\,\,\,\,接下来证明若$u(t)$和$v(t)$是方程(\ref{24})的两个解, 则成立 \[ \int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau},\forall t>0. \]

记 \[S=\left\{ x:\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau},\forall t\in \left[ 0,x \right] \right\}. \] 则因为$\varepsilon\in S$,故$S$非空. 若结论不成立, 则$T=\mathrm{sup} S<+\infty .$ 显然此时$\forall 0\le a<b<T$, 成立 \[ \int_{\left[ a,b \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0. \]

故因为$\left[ 0,T \right)$可以表示成 \[ \left[ 0,T \right) =\cup_{n=1}^{\infty}{\left[ \left( 1-\frac{1}{n} \right) T,\left( 1-\frac{1}{n+1} \right) T \right]}, \] 并且等式右边的每个集合互不相交, 故 \[\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right)}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{\int_{\left[ T-\frac{T}{n},T-\frac{T}{n+1} \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=0.\]
这意味着$T\in S$. 故存在$a\in\left( T,T+\frac{\varepsilon}{2} \right] $, 使得$\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{\left( v\left( \tau \right) -u\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\ne 0.$

因为$u(t),v(t)$是方程(\ref{24})的两个解, 故 \[ \frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}=\frac{1-\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}{\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}. \]

化简可得 \[ \int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}. \]

记 \[ \int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} = p, \int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon,T \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,T \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} = q. \]

则 $$\begin{aligned} &\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ a-\varepsilon ,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \\ &=\left( q+\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \left( p+\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) -\left( q+\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \left( p+\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \\ &=p\left( \int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) -q\left( \int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) \\ &=\left( p-q \right) \left( \int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) =\int_{\left[ 0,a-\varepsilon \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( \int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right). \end{aligned}$$

即 \[ \int_{\left[ 0,a-\varepsilon \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( \int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) =\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \] 因为$\int_{\left[ 0,a-\varepsilon \right]}{u\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}<1$, 故$\int_{\left[ 0,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ T,a \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0$, 矛盾.

Speak.Content: 最后只需要证明如果两个勒贝格可积函数在每一个闭区间上的积分都是相等的, 那么它们只相差一 个几乎处处为0的函数就好了.
这里我直接照抄了周民强上面的方法, 所以就不再分析思路了, 直接给出答案:

LongSpeak.Content: 第三步\,\,\,\, 最后证明方程的解都可以表示成 \[ v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}+c\left( t \right) \] 的形式, 其中$c(t)=0,\text{a.e.}\,t\ge0$. 首先, 上式显然是方程的解, 故只需证明方程的解只能具有上式 子的形式.

设$u(t),v(t)$是方程(\ref{24})的两个解, 则对于给定的$T>0$,$\int_{\left[ 0,t \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0,\,\forall t\in[0,T].$ 若存在 可测集$E$满足$m(E)>0$, 且$u(x)>v(x)$, 则存在闭集$F\subset E$满足$m(F)>0$. 设$G=[0,T]-F$, 则 \[ \int_G{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\int_F{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0. \]

设$G=\cup_{n\ge 0}^{}{\left( a_n,b_n \right)}$, 则 \[ \sum_{n\ge 0}^{}{\int_{\left( a_n,b_n \right)}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}}<0. \] 故存在$k$使得 \[ \int_{\left[ a_k,b_k \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left( a_k,b_k \right)}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}<0. \]

这与 \[ \int_{\left[ a_k,b_k \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_{\left[ 0,b_k \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}-\int_{\left[ 0,a_k \right]}{\left( u\left( \tau \right) -v\left( \tau \right) \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=0 \] 矛盾. 这个命题对$\forall T>0$都成立, 故$u(t)\le v(t), \,\text{a.e.}\,t\ge 0$. 同理$u(t)\ge v(t), \,\text{a.e.}\,t\ge 0$, 故$u(t) = v(t), \,\text{a.e.}\,t\ge 0$. 故方程所有可能的解只能是\[ v(t)=v_0\left( t-\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right] \varepsilon \right) \left( 1-\int_{\left[ 0,\varepsilon \right]}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^{\left[ \frac{t}{\varepsilon} \right]}+c\left( t \right) . \]

Speak.Content: 好吧, 总之最后我们解答了第二个问题, 这个时候速度同样是指数衰减的.

并且可以算出$\int_{n\varepsilon}^{\left( n+1 \right) \varepsilon}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( 1-\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^n.$

所以同样有$\int_0^{+\infty}{v\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}=\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}{\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau}\left( 1-\int_0^{\varepsilon}{v_0\left( \tau \right) \mathrm{d}\tau} \right) ^n}=1.$
